messages:
Maya (security-docs): PR #6782 is up — updates to SOC2 retention wording + a new section clarifying retention vs legal holds, plus an SDK example for redaction. tagging legal + docs. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6782 :eyes:

Liam (Legal): Looking now. Quick Q: current draft says 'audit logs retained for 90 days unless otherwise requested.' We should be explicit: 'Default retention = 90 days; customers may request extended retention via contract or legal hold.' Is that accurate?

Ana (Docs): I can rephrase. Draft suggestion: "Default audit log retention is 90 days. Extended retention and legal holds are available through contractual agreements or by contacting Redwood support." Should we call out who can request (account owner / legal)?

Sam Lee (eng): From infra: yes we support per-tenant TTL and a legal_hold flag that prevents auto-deletion. Also important: redaction runs in the export pipeline (post-ingest) for customers using managed exports; for private/on-prem we recommend pre-ingest filters. I'll add a Go snippet for the SDK to show how to request an export with redaction and how to set a legal hold.

Maya (security-docs): Can you paste the Go snippet here so I can drop it into the PR?

Sam Lee (eng): ```go
// Example: request export + redaction and set a legal hold
client := redwood.NewClient("$REDWOOD_API_KEY")
req := &redwood.ExportRequest{
    TenantID: "tenant_123",
    StartTime: "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z",
    EndTime: "2024-03-31T23:59:59Z",
    RedactFields: []string{"user_email", "ssn"}, // fields removed from exported events
    ApplyLegalHold: true, // prevents TTL-based deletion for this tenant
}
resp, err := client.CreateExport(context.Background(), req)
if err != nil {
    // handle
}
fmt.Println("export queued:", resp.ExportID)
```

Sam Lee (eng): And a quick curl example for audit export redaction: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"tenant_id":"tenant_123","start_time":"2024-01-01T00:00:00Z","end_time":"2024-03-31T23:59:59Z","redact_fields":["user_email","ssn"]}'
```

docs-bot: link-checker: failed — found outdated link to /compliance/audit in the PR. Suggest replacing with /security/compliance/retention.

Kevin (platform): Also, SOC2 auditors often ask 'who may request extended retention or place a legal hold?' Recommend adding a short enumerated list: account owner, designated legal contact, and authorized compliance admins.

Liam (Legal): Agreed. Also prefer neutral phrasing: replace 'we will' with 'Redwood provides' or 'customers must request.' Keep it prescriptive and avoid operational commitments outside contract.

Ana (Docs): I'll make the copy edits, add the list of authorized requesters, and swap the broken link. I'll also embed Sam's Go snippet and the curl example.

Maya (security-docs): Thanks — I'll update the PR description with a short summary for the auditors and tag Legal for final sign-off once you push. Any objections to shipping this as a docs-only change?

Liam (Legal): No objections. Once copy updated, I'll do a final pass.

Sam Lee (eng): FYI: if you want to mention timing, our retention TTL enforcement job runs hourly; legal_hold overrides it immediately. Might be useful in the operational appendix.

Ana (Docs): Noted, I'll add a one-line operational note under 'How retention is enforced'.

Maya (security-docs): Great — target to merge after legal sign-off. I'll ping again when PR updated. :thumbsup:
